slice: Post-build broad review of the Formation Operating Brief, validated device return through Personal Bellows, stale-consent invalidation, unresolved-conversation readout, and continued matching/provider boundaries.
sharedContext: Actual custody-validated Bean and Skybro Formation/Operating Brief receipts controlled this local build.

A member-authored revision accepted by both practice records can enter the Operating Brief; untouched generated joint prompts, private notes, predictions, proposals, objections, parked, and withdrawn material cannot.
Partly completed sections now show topic labels and current state under Still to settle without copying private content or drafting clauses.
Save on this device now restores the Brief only after validating it against the restored Formation source; changing accepted wording removes the saved Brief and derived shared-action draft.
TypeScript, source contracts, Bean hostile browser walk, 16px desktop/mobile legibility walk, and Formation to Personal Bellows round trip pass with a clean console.
No provider call, credentials, paid call, SQL/schema/RLS, production mutation, push, deploy, merge, new task, subagent, secondary model, environment, or foreground input is authorized.
liveStrings: Not yet written by both people.
Operating Brief restored from this device and checked against the current accepted wording.
An accepted answer changed, so the older brief and shared-action draft were removed.
knownGaps: This is still a synthetic browser-local practice Werkle, not real two-member account custody.
Formation behavior and private prediction data must remain excluded from matching and Bellows personalization.
Provider activation remains separate in Crucible; no financial, identity, phone, payment, or background result exists from this build.
Lady Jessica and Doozer require their own machine routes and may not be counted merely because outbox packets exist.
